verdict.rationale: The public GitHub repo exposes readable source: runnable scripts, an engine facade with a `backends/` directory, and a pytest unit-test suite. That covers the 'read the source' half of the story. Nothing in the pack names a license, so the 'open license' half is unverified. missing for 10: any evidence of the license type (e.g. an OSI-approved license file or README badge), confirmation that all components (mobile/desktop apps, native engines) are covered by it, independent corroboration.
